q: Do skylights and daylight panels cut factory lighting emissions?
title: Skylights: lighting savings
short: Yes, if lights actually switch off when daylight is enough. Daylight sheets or light pipes replace lighting kWh during the day, at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25. Add daylight sensors or zoned switching, or people leave lights on. In air-conditioned areas, check the extra heat gain.

ul: Daylight sensors or timers on the lighting circuits.
Zones by row, so lights near skylights switch off first.
Clean sheets, since dust cuts light.

p: Sub-meter the lighting circuit and compare daytime kWh before and after, over the same months.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel invoices and electricity bills and applies IPCC 2006 factors and the CEA grid factor (0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25), so you can compare Scope 1 and 2 before and after a change from the documents themselves.

sources.label: CEA CO2 Baseline Database for the Indian Power Sector
